components.name: Primary Button

components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-btn-primary">บันทึกคำขอ</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 10px 16px; font-family: "LINE Seed Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; color: #ffffff; background: #18a0fb; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0d8ce8; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(24, 160, 251, 0.35); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #0d8ce8; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 10px 16px; font-family: "LINE Seed Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: #e5e5e5; background: transparent; border: 1.5px solid #383838; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: #525252; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(24, 160, 251, 0.35); outline-offset: 2px; border-color: #18a0fb; }

components.name: Glass Input
components.description: Text field on dark glass surfaces.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: "LINE Seed Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: #e5e5e5; } .ds-input-glass { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #ffffff; background: #2c2c2c; border: 1.5px solid #383838; border-radius: 12px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-input-glass::placeholder { color: #737373; } .ds-input-glass:hover { border-color: #525252; } .ds-input-glass:focus { border-color: #18a0fb; }

narrative.overview:
Concrete Works reads like a control room for pour operations: calm, legible, and authoritative. Surfaces are layered with tinted neutrals and restrained glass so status, volumes, and workflow steps stay scannable on a phone at a job site or on a wide desktop in the office. The system serves three balanced jobs (requests, CST/quality, ops/admin) without letting any one screen feel like a marketing dashboard.

Density follows context: compact tables and forms on desktop (pour-desktop, fluid type from Figma 1440), slightly larger touch targets on mobile (390-based scale). Motion confirms state (page enter, press, status pulse) rather than decorating idle screens. Four theme variants (dark, light, green, pink) swap the same token names; dark is the default for field and night use.
keyCharacteristics: Single sans family (LINE Seed Sans) with tabular numerals for metrics
Accent blue (#18a0fb) reserved for primary actions, focus rings, and current nav
Glass surfaces (pour-glass*) with subtle borders and small shadows
Semantic ink ramp (--pour-ink-0 … --pour-ink-3) instead of raw gray on color
MUI primitives aligned to 12px radius and textTransform: none
Breakpoints: mobile portrait; pour-desktop landscape ≥768px; pour-wide ≥1280px

rules.name: The Token-Only Rule
rules.body: New screens use var(--pour-*) and var(--glass-*). Do not introduce raw slate-*, indigo-*, or hex one-offs on dashboard or form surfaces.

rules.name: The Accent Sparingly Rule
rules.body: #18a0fb marks what is actionable or selected. If everything is blue, nothing is.

rules.name: The Fixed-Scale Rule
rules.body: Product UI uses the text-pour-* scale and pour-mobile/pour-pc fluid tokens, not marketing-style clamp() display headings.

rules.name: The Table Head Rule
rules.body: Table headers use type.tableHead (normal case, medium weight), not uppercase grid labels.

rules.name: The Flat Form Rule
rules.body: Form fields do not animate layout or background on every keystroke; border color shifts to --pour-accent on focus only.

rules.name: The Reduced Motion Rule
rules.body: All pour-page-*, stagger, card-lift, and status pulse animations disable under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

dos: Do use --pour-ink-* and --glass-* for all new UI on interactive surfaces.
Do use tabular-nums / font-mono class for volumes, dates, and dashboard KPI values.
Do respect pour-desktop vs mobile layouts.
Do keep primary actions verb + object in labels.
Do provide focus-visible styles and honor prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't add styles that break consistency with the current token system.
Don't use gradient text (bg-clip-text + gradient) for headings or brand.
Don't ship SaaS-style KPI cards (gradient border frames, unrelated indigo/violet accents).
Don't put text-slate-* on saturated accent buttons or chart toggles.
Don't use colored border-left stripes thicker than 1px as card accents.
Don't nest glass cards without pour-glass-muted or flat inset.
